name: workspace-path-completion
description: Autocomplete workspace files and directories while typing string literals.

commands.title: Workspace Path Completion: Show Index Stats

workspacePathCompletion.enabled.description: Enable workspace path completion inside string literals.

workspacePathCompletion.languages.description: Language IDs in which completion is enabled.

workspacePathCompletion.exclude.description: Additional glob patterns excluded from the path index.

workspacePathCompletion.include.description: Optional include-only glob patterns. Empty means include all non-excluded files.

workspacePathCompletion.preferRelativeTo.description: Prefer paths relative to the current file when appropriate.

workspacePathCompletion.javaResourceAwar.description: In Java strings, expose files under configured resource roots as classpath resource paths and adapt leading-slash semantics for Class vs ClassLoader resource APIs.

workspacePathCompletion.rankingBackend.description: Ranking backend. auto uses fzf when available and falls back to the internal matcher.

workspacePathCompletion.fzfPath.description: Path or executable name for fzf.

workspacePathCompletion.fzfMinCandidates.description: Minimum candidate count before auto mode uses fzf.

workspacePathCompletion.debug.description: Write index/completion timing information to the output channel.

workspacePathCompletion.resourceRoots.description: Glob patterns identifying Java resource source roots. Files beneath these roots are offered using classpath resource semantics.
